explanation: Each layer stores a key and a value for every key/value head: 2 × 8 × 128 values, and 40 layers make 81,920 values, or 163,840 bytes in bf16 (160 KiB per token). Query heads add nothing to the cache, so using 32 heads instead of 8 gives a 4× overestimate; forgetting either keys or values halves the answer. At 8,192 tokens that is 1.25 GiB per sequence, which is why the key/value head count matters.
